name: DaemonSet coverage + fix an unschedulable pod
objective: CKA › Workloads & Scheduling. Drill EVERY way to control where pods land, harder than the exam: node labels + nodeSelector, taints & tolerations (Equal + Exists), required and preferred nodeAffinity, pod anti-affinity spread, manual nodeName scheduling, DaemonSet coverage, and a no-hint diagnose-and-fix for an unschedulable pod. Graded exactly, per requirement.

questions.title: DaemonSet on every node
questions.teach:
A **DaemonSet** runs one copy of a pod on every matching node, adding/removing as nodes join/leave. Like a Deployment but with no `replicas`, and `spec.selector.matchLabels` must match the template labels.

**Gotcha:** control-plane nodes (and your tainted `$W1`) carry `NoSchedule` taints — to cover *every* node the template needs `tolerations: [{operator: Exists}]`, which tolerates all taints.
questions.prompt:
In `sched-learn` create DaemonSet `node-agent` (`busybox:1.36`, `sleep 3600`, label `app=node-agent`) with a toleration broad enough (`operator: Exists`) to run on **every** node including the control plane and the tainted `$W1`.

Target: `desiredNumberScheduled` == number of nodes and `numberReady` matches.
questions.hint: DaemonSet selector `app=node-agent`; template `tolerations: [{operator: Exists}]`. Verify with `kubectl -n sched-learn get ds node-agent` vs `kubectl get nodes`.
questions.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: node-agent
  namespace: sched-learn
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: node-agent
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: node-agent
    spec:
      tolerations:
      - operator: Exists
      containers:
      - name: c
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ["sleep","3600"]
EOF

verification.description: DaemonSet node-agent runs one ready pod on every node

questions.title: Diagnose & fix: a pod that won't schedule
questions.teach:
A pod stuck `Pending` with **no node assigned** is a scheduling failure — run `kubectl describe pod

` and read **Events**: `0/N nodes are available` names the reason (a nodeSelector/affinity that matches nothing, or a taint with no toleration). **Gotcha:** fix the **Deployment template**, not the pod — the ReplicaSet recreates the pod, then confirm with `kubectl rollout status`.
questions.prompt:
Deployment `sched-diag` in `sched-learn` shows `0/1` — its pod is `Pending` and never schedules. Diagnose the scheduling fault and fix it so the Deployment reports an available replica. Don't delete and rebuild from scratch — find and fix what's wrong.

Target: Deployment `sched-diag` has at least 1 available replica.
questions.hint: `kubectl -n sched-learn describe pod -l app=sched-diag` → the events say no node matches its `nodeSelector` (disktype=nvme). Either remove that nodeSelector or point it at a label a node actually has, then watch `rollout status`.
questions.solution:
# describe shows: 0/3 nodes available — node(s) didn't match nodeSelector disktype=nvme.
# No node has disktype=nvme, so remove the impossible selector (an untainted node will take it).
kubectl -n sched-learn patch deployment sched-diag --type=json \
  -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/template/spec/nodeSelector"}]'
kubectl -n sched-learn rollout status deployment/sched-diag

verification.description: Deployment sched-diag has >=1 available replica (scheduling fault fixed)
